page_title: TOR 0-3 ATA | Torino v Atalanta 21/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Andrea Colombo is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Faustino Anjorin (Torino) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
89' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
88' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
87' Substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana walks off the pitch and Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Yunus Musah (Atalanta) coming on for Marten de Roon.
86' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) replaces Nikola Krstovic.
86' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) attempts to find Duvan Zapata, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Faustino Anjorin (Torino) is coming onto the pitch as Nikola Vlasic cannot continue after picking up an injury.
80' The ball is cleared after Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
80' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
79' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
78' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) attempts to feed Nikola Krstovic with a chip pass, but Franco Israel reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
77' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
76' Corner kicks – 1:0.
73' Cesare Casadei (Torino) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Marco Carnesecchi.
73' Marco Carnesecchi anticipates the direction of the penalty by Duvan Zapata (Torino). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
73' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is going to take the penalty!
73' It’s a PENALTY to Torino after the VAR review!
71' Referee Andrea Colombo makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Torino. Let’s see what happens!
71' Saul Coco (Torino) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
70' The corner from Kristjan Asllani (Torino) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi.
70' Duvan Zapata (Torino) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save. Good work from Torino as they win a corner.
69' Duvan Zapata (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giovanni Simeone.

68' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but is stopped by a great save from Franco Israel and the score remains the same.

67' The most active player in today's match is definitely Giovanni Simeone (Torino). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!

67' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save to stop the effort going into the bottom left corner.
66' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' Che Adams (Torino) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
64' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
63' 3:7 – the total goal attempt statistics. The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.
60' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) sends a long ball forward to Che Adams, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
60' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
58' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Che Adams darts into free space to control the ball.
54' Saul Coco (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
51' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
51' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
50' Cesare Casadei (Torino) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul. Atalanta are awarded a free kick.
49' A pass by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

48' That didn't go as planned! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Marco Carnesecchi, who easily kept it out.
46' Marco Baroni makes a switch. Cesare Casadei is coming on in place of Ivan Ilic (Torino) at the start of the second period.
46' Marco Baroni makes a half-time substitution. Che Adams comes on in place of Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Baroni probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Guillermo Maripan (Torino). He is replaced by Adrien Tameze.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+2' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
44' A clumsy foul by Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle.

42' What a chance that is! Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
40' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
38' 0 - 3 Goal! Kamaldeen Sulemana puts the ball on a plate for Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:3.
34' 0 - 2 Goal! Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
34' What a chance that is! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
32' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:3. Shots on target – 0:2.
30' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Lazar Samardzic laid the ball off to Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
27' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is substituted due to injury. Ivan Juric gives a chance to Honest Ahanor.
26' Isak Hien (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
24' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a long cross over to Zakaria Aboukhlal, but Marco Carnesecchi comes forward to gather the ball.
22' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
19' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) picks out Nikola Krstovic with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
18' The ball is laid off to Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Franco Israel to make a decent save.
16' Ball possession – 32:68.
14' Atalanta enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
10' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Nicola Zalewski is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
10' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
9' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle after Saul Coco (Torino) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Atalanta get a free kick.

7' Saul Coco (Torino) plays a terrific long ball forward to Zakaria Aboukhlal, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
6' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul after Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents. Atalanta have a free kick.
2' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Franco Israel punches the ball away.
1' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Andrea Colombo will referee today's match.
